name: adaptive-planning-programming-proof-gate

material.persisted_state_semantics: Changes persisted-state semantics, destructive DDL, a backfill, or a migration with material lock, rollout, or consumer risk.
material.public_external_contract: Changes a public API, external payload, webhook, wire contract, semantics, or backward-compatibility guarantee.
material.executable_auth_security_privacy: Changes authentication, authorization, tenant isolation, permission semantics, secret lifecycle, security, or privacy enforcement.
material.billing_accounting: Changes billing, charging, quota accounting, balances, pricing, or money semantics.
material.destructive_data_money_privacy: Introduces a credible data-loss, money-loss, privacy-leak, or destructive-operation risk.

boundary.provider_routing_wire_model_identity: Changes provider selection, failover, quota ownership, provider wire behavior, or externally meaningful model identity.
boundary.deployment_topology_production_rollout_r: Changes deployment topology, broad production rollout behavior, process placement, or runtime ownership.
boundary.coordinated_cross_service_state: Requires coordinated state or contract changes across services or repositories.
boundary.complex_rollback: Cannot be reverted locally without coordinated migration, rollout, or state repair.

bounded_change.effect: When every fact is proven and no hard effect is present or unresolved, planning is no higher than light.

risk_groups.design: Material solution ambiguity, a new feature boundary, or an architectural decision.
risk_groups.reach: User/operator workflow or multi-module reach broader than a local presentation change.
risk_groups.runtime: Performance, load, async, scheduler, sync, session-state, relay, or degraded-runtime behavior.
risk_groups.proof_rollback: Critical behavior is difficult to prove locally or rollback is not a direct bounded revert.

rules.lightweight: No present or unresolved hard effect, direct work, and no independent risk group.
rules.light: No present or unresolved hard effect and either a proven bounded change or one to two independent risk groups.
rules.full: Any present or unresolved hard effect, complex coordination, or at least three independent risk groups when bounded change is not proven.

rules.direct: Main agent implements and verifies; no loop artifacts.
rules.light: Main agent implements; one stable independent reviewer gets an initial review and at most one recheck; no persisted run.
rules.guarded: One stable independent implementer and one stable independent reviewer use a compact run; the same implementer fixes and the same reviewer rechecks.
rules.full: Preserve the existing independent implementer, fixer, and fresh full-QA flow.

request_constraints.ordinary: Does not request a Programming Loop.
request_constraints.programming-loop: Sets minimum programming profile light but does not force full.
request_constraints.light-programming-loop: Sets both minimum and maximum programming profile light; if facts require guarded or full, return HUMAN_DECISION_REQUIRED with reason LIGHT_PROFILE_CEILING and the exact proposed profile before admitting work.

fact_rules.present_or_unresolved_hard_effect: Requires full unless the effect is no longer present or unresolved; a task label or claimed main-agent shape cannot lower it.
fact_rules.resolved_full_planning_to_local_fix: When full planning resolved uncertainty to a local bounded fix with no present or unresolved hard effect, guarded remains available.
fact_rules.none: Allows direct unless an explicit request raises the minimum.

signals.release: Broad release, deployment, complex migration, post-deploy/live proof, or mandatory project gate.
signals.contract: API boundary, bounded migration, secret/runtime boundary, or focused integration contract.
signals.focused: Local executable behavior with an existing focused check or one named regression/negative test.
signals.static: Docs, copy, prompt, non-executable config, parse, syntax, readback, diff, or wiring.

proof.full_suite_rule: A full suite is allowed only for release proof or an explicit mandatory project rule.
proof.full_qa_definition: Independent review of material risks and plan coverage; it does not automatically mean a full test suite.

artifacts.lightweight: No run, plan, approval, or handoff artifact.
artifacts.light: No persisted .ai-loop/runs, plan, approval, or handoff artifact.
artifacts.guarded: Persist input/decision.json and compact state v2.
artifacts.full: Persist input/decision.json, approved plan and handoff where applicable, and the existing full Planning/Programming Loop artifacts.

constraints: Classify effects, not keywords, filenames, repository names, task labels, or lines changed.
A backend repository name is not a scope capsule.
Provider-adjacent copy, labels, docs, metadata, and local config are not hard effects unless executable selection, wire, identity, accounting, auth, or external/state semantics change.
A migration filename is not a hard effect when an additive nullable change is proven bounded without backfill, material lock, rollout, or consumer risk.
Do not auto-escalate a selected programming profile; stop with HUMAN_DECISION_REQUIRED and propose the exact higher profile.
Do not repeat a check on the same input snapshot or create an exact-wording test for ordinary prose.
